title: ONE 100 KT NUKE
OVER WHITEHALL
yt_title: One Nuke Over London's Whitehall: Simulated Blast #shorts
hook: The simulated warhead bursts over Whitehall: a fireball 380 metres in radius, and at 640 metres heavy buildings do not stand.

title: ONE 100 KT NUKE
ON GREATER LONDON
yt_title: What One Nuke Would Do to London, Ring by Ring #shorts
hook: At 3.1 kilometres the blast falls to five pounds per square inch and most houses collapse, a circle of 31 square kilometres.

title: ONE 100 KT NUKE
ON FASLANE
yt_title: One Nuke on Britain's Submarine Base: Simulated Faslane #shorts
hook: At 7.6 minutes the first simulated warhead bursts on the ground at Faslane, home of Britain's four Vanguard submarines, and the fallout drifts east.
